headings.usage: Use for all headlines, section titles, and names. It gives a luxurious, romantic, and premium editorial feel.

body.usage: Use for all body text, paragraphs, forms, and small UI elements. Clean, modern, highly legible.

accent.usage: Use sparingly for romantic accents, like 'Manas & Kavita' signature or small love quotes.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/60 border border-white/50 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(212,175,55,0.08)] rounded-3xl
visual_enhancers.borders: rounded-full, rounded-3xl, delicate 1px border of gold/20 or white/60
visual_enhancers.decorations: Floating hearts (framer-motion floating animation), floral border SVGs at section edges, sparkles/stars around headlines.

layouts.hero: 100vh full-screen. Centered content. Kinetic masked reveal on load.
layouts.gallery: Asymmetric Bento Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6) with varying spans to create a luxurious editorial feel.
layouts.timeline: Vertical centered line, alternating left/right content blocks with Framer Motion scroll triggers.
layouts.general: Generous spacing. py-24 to py-32 for sections to give breathing room. Container max-w-7xl mx-auto px-6.

grids.bento_art_mode: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Images span multiple columns and rows to break monotony.

motion.scrolling: Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. It is mandatory for the premium feel.
motion.reveals: Framer Motion line-by-line text reveals on scroll (y: 50, opacity: 0 to y: 0, opacity: 1, stagger: 0.1).
motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on buttons (scale 1.05, shadow-glow), subtle continuous floating animations on decorative elements (hearts/sparkles) using repeat: Infinity, yoyo.
motion.parallax: Subtle background image parallax on the hero and gallery sections using useScroll and useTransform.
motion.scratch_card: Canvas-based or Framer Motion drag mask reveal for the wedding date scratch-off interaction.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure #2C2C2C text has high contrast over pastel backgrounds. Avoid white text on blush pink.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all Framer animations.
accessibility.testing: All interactive buttons/links/forms MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='rsvp-submit-button').

media.images: High-quality, rounded corners (rounded-3xl or rounded-full for portraits). Max height 80vh on mobile.
media.icons: Use lucide-react with thin stroke widths (strokeWidth={1}) for an elegant look. Heart, Calendar, MapPin, Sparkles.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use framer-motion for 2.5D parallax and floating elements. Avoid heavy 3D canvases to keep the site extremely fast and airy, fitting the romantic theme. If a 3D ring or petal particle system is desired, use tsparticles for lightweight floral confetti.

hero_background.description: Dried red and cream flowers on white. Use as soft hero background texture.

couple_placeholder.description: Indian couple in traditional attire sitting under a floral canopy. Use as the main couple illustration/image.

haldi_ceremony.description: Joyful Haldi ceremony. Use in the Wedding Event Timeline for the Haldi section.

dj_night.description: Vibrant indoor evening event with elegant lights. Use for the DJ Night section.

reception.description: Luxurious dining setup with chandeliers. Use for the Reception section.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, @studio-freight/lenis (or lenis), lucide-react, react-fast-marquee, canvas-confetti, clsx, tailwind-merge.
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling globally in the App wrapper.
Build a signature hero section with a masked text reveal ('Manas & Kavita' elegantly rising line-by-line).
Construct the Interactive Scratch Card using a simple HTML5 Canvas overlaid on the 'Save the Date / 24 Jan 2027' text. On drag/touch, clear the canvas pixels to reveal.
Design the Our Love Story and Wedding Event Timeline as vertical scrolling experiences with sticky dates and fade-in illustrations.
For the RSVP Form, use standard Shadcn/UI-like pure React components styled with glassmorphism (bg-white/60, backdrop-blur-xl). No real backend needed, just show a success toast or state on submit.
Include an editorial marquee (using react-fast-marquee) with pale pink background and gold/dark text reading romantic phrases or the wedding hashtag.
Do NOT use completely transparent backgrounds under the navigation header if content scrolls behind it. Use a glassmorphism nav bar.
Embed a stylized Google Map iframe for the Wedding Venue section, accompanied by a 'Get Directions' button.
Do NOT use 'Inter', 'Roboto', or 'Open Sans' for any text. Stick to 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Outfit'.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Avoid generic centered layouts except in hero sections. Use asymmetry and generous spacing (p-8 to p-24) to create tension and luxury.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism effects (12-24px blur).
Do not apply universal transitions like 'transition: all'. Target specific properties.
Do not center-align the whole app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or softly rounded, subtle gold/blush gradients, hover glow).
Never use AI assistant emojis for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax, entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using the provided image URLs. Do not use placeholder text for images.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes for testing.
